responsibility: Contains the core implementation of the 32-bit Arm backend. It owns target hooks for instruction selection, addressing, costs, scheduling support, prologue/epilogue generation, asm printing, builtin expansion, option parsing and target reconfiguration, architecture/CPU database interpretation, literal-pool and minipool handling, branch generation, vector and MVE support hooks, selftests, and many global target-state computations that connect GCC middle-end operations to Arm RTL and assembly output.
same_name_distinction: Is the main C++ implementation file for the Arm backend’s target hooks and code-generation logic, as distinct from arm.h’s macro/configuration interface, arm.md’s RTL machine-description patterns, and arm.opt’s option-table definitions.
